input.title: ‘Hiding in plain sight’: organised crime, financial crime and property
input.authors: L’Hoiry X.; Rugg J.; Parton L.E.; Antonopoulos G.A.; Colliver K.; Hunter C.; Page G.; O’Malley L.
input.abstract: This special issue of Trends in Organised Crime brings together recent empirical research on organised crime, financial crime and property. The collection comprises six original contributions, which collectively reveal the multiple ways property intersects with organised and financial crime – from organised violence against property, predatory landlordism, and domestic cannabis cultivation, to mortgage and real estate fraud, and money laundering. © The Author(s) 2025.
